integrity: All identities proved for every positive integer in the stated domain; finite verification is supplementary. Prior published termwise integrality is attributed to Guo.
scientific_limitations: Parity modulo 16 and digit-sum lower bounds only; no exact two-adic valuations at arbitrary non-power-of-two indices. Priority beyond the specifically inspected primary literature is not independently certified.
title: Proof of the binary-parity criterion for Sun's normalized binomial convolution
